text.id: Dibaca. Nggak dibales. Seminggu sebelum Sekar hilang, ada yang nelpon Tasya. Dan Tasya nggak pernah cerita ke siapa-siapa.
text.en: Read. No reply. A week before Sekar vanished, someone called Tasya. And Tasya never told anyone.

text.id: "Maaf." Jam setengah dua pagi. Buat apa?
text.en: "I'm sorry." At half past one in the morning. For what?

text.id: "Jangan percaya T," gue bilang pelan. Dinda ngelirik gue. "Lo pikir Tasya...?" Gue nggak tahu. Tapi Tasya tahu sesuatu.
text.en: "Don't trust T," I say quietly. Dinda glances at me. "You think Tasya...?" I don't know. But Tasya knows something.

text.id: "Tasya kemarin bilang ke gue dia nggak tahu apa-apa," kata Dinda. Suaranya pelan, tapi tangannya ngepal.
text.en: "Tasya told me yesterday she doesn't know anything," Dinda says. Her voice is quiet, but her hand is a fist.
